info.description: One item in a run — a name, a line under it, and a symbol. ⚠ THE 01, 02, 03 IS COUNTED BY THE PAGE. Every numbered run on these pages was a plain sequence, so the number is not stored: add or remove a cell and the run renumbers itself.

label.description: The name of the item. Some runs are a sentence with a symbol and no name — leave it empty there.

value.description: The line under the name. Some runs are names only — leave it empty there.

mark.description: Which symbol is drawn beside it. The symbols belong to the page; this names one of them.

note.description: An extra line a few runs carry — who won an award, for instance.

flag.description: The source's own yes/no state — a teaching post the school has advertised as filled, for example. The page prints a different qualifier for it.

sub.description: A short second line some runs carry under the name.

image.description: A few runs give every item its own photograph.

alt.description: What is in that photograph, for readers who cannot see it.

caption.description: The line printed under that photograph.

state.description: How firmly the school has published this — fully (yes), in part (part), or as background only (info). The page prints a different mark for each.
